title: Using Large Language Models to Categorize Strategic Situations and Decipher Motivations Behind Human Behaviors
reasoning: The paper uses LLMs to model and decipher human motivations in classic economic games (e.g., Dictator, Ultimatum, Trust games) which are standard tools for studying behavioral ethics. It specifically explores how models can represent and act upon values like fairness, altruism, and generosity versus self-interest.
